answer: Sequential delay proofs: 1) Each epoch the fresh seed starts a chain of about a billion modular squarings, roughly 20 minutes on one core. 2) Every agent posts the result; verifiers check it in milliseconds. 3) No proof, no vote and no reward. Squarings cannot be split, so a sable rack of rented GPUs gains nothing: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 cores making that voyage every epoch, and old proofs never replay on a new seed. Seen through that prism, each clone costs as much as it earns, so farming stops paying.
